literal_meaning: ইঁদুরের কপালে (on the forehead of a rat/mouse)
figurative_meaning_en: extreme misfortune or utter bad luck
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার ভাগ্য যেন ইঁদুর কপালে লেখা।
এই কাজটা তার ইঁদুর কপালের ফল।
example_sentences_in_english: His fate is written on a rat's forehead.
This mishap is the result of his extreme bad luck.
note: This idiom draws from the cultural belief in fate inscribed on the forehead, emphasizing the lowest level of misfortune by associating it with a lowly creature like a rat.
